name: Tesseract Native Forward Kinematics
description: Return one exact native Tesseract robot-relative metre pose.

inputParameters.name: planner
inputParameters.description: TesseractPlanner from Tesseract Planner. Only forward_kinematics_native is used.

inputParameters.name: robot_cell_state
inputParameters.description: Exact RobotCellState supplying the native joint configuration.

inputParameters.name: link_name
inputParameters.description: Exact native link name whose pose is requested.

inputParameters.name: group
inputParameters.description: Optional planning-group name. Unconnected uses the cell main group.

outputParameters.name: pose
outputParameters.description: Exact native Pose in robot-relative metres.
